Repository 1.0.9 — depth-first product strategy.

- Reframes future development around methodology, safety, orchestration, project continuity, human-readable artifacts, and executable evals rather than catalog-style expansion across Yandex APIs.
- Makes service transport explicitly replaceable: official MCP/connectors may replace local clients without replacing interpretation, provenance, reconciliation, or safety contracts.
- Prioritizes mechanically enforced write safety (`preview_id`/approval binding, rollback where valid, post-write verification, bulk guards) before broader write adoption.
- Introduces the planned `.yandex-ai/` domain-memory contract with `USER_STATED` provenance, append-only decision audit, freshness-aware baselines, hypotheses, no secrets, and memory-as-data semantics.
- Prioritizes one roughly 10-minute read-only end-to-end workflow plus versioned JSON, self-contained HTML reports, Mermaid/DOT exports, and predictable artifacts; Electron/desktop UI remains out of scope until a demonstrated multi-project/compliance need exists.
- Promotes adversarial eval fixtures toward an executable multi-model benchmark and defines a 90-day external-validation loop with a low-maintenance fallback if real usage signal does not appear.
- Freezes Tracker, Yandex 360, Maps, AppMetrica, YandexGPT, and SpeechKit expansion until a distinct user problem, external signal, and product-boundary decision justify one item independently.
- This release is repository-only: no plugin runtime behavior or plugin SemVer changes are included, and no plugin tags are published.

Plugin versions are unchanged:
- Yandex Direct 2.0.1
- Yandex Metrika 2.0.0
- Yandex Webmaster 2.0.0
- Yandex Wordstat 1.1.2
- Yandex Search 1.0.2
- Yandex SEO 1.1.2
- Yandex Marketing 1.1.0
